content.comment_body: Hello, I am facing an issue with [product_name] [version_no]. A client enables password protection on their program, switching to Operator mode before delivering machines. However, after switching to Operator mode, the clock menu on the [product_name] screen disappears, only being visible in Admin mode. Since the clock feature is essential for the end customer to start the machine, its absence in Operator mode creates a compliance issue. The OEM cannot send the machine to the customer in Admin mode. I checked the manual (pages 70 & 71) from the following link, but the clock option isn't available in Operator mode. Is there a way to include the clock option in Operator mode? [url] Regards [user_name]
To my knowledge, there isn't a solution for this.

It currently seems impossible within the existing functionality. You might consider using an external timer relay to address this requirement. Best Regards, [user_name] If you found this helpful, please rate the post.

Hi, When switched to Operator mode, users can only adjust options included in message texts. This mode is designed to prevent operators from making unintended setting changes. Here are some alternatives for setting date and time: - Use [product_name] communication module with GPS signal - Rely on NTP services from a networked NTP server if available - Synchronize using communication modules - Set date and time before shipment (machine remains powered up to 20 days), then switch to Operator mode - Adjust date and time through the programming software Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report a substantial limitation with [product_name] [version_no], as the clock menu needed for machine operation is inaccessible in Operator mode due to password protections. This prevents meeting essential customer requirements while maintaining secure deployment, forcing consideration of external solutions and causing frustration with the device's current capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the ability to access the clock menu in Operator mode to comply with mandatory customer needs, without compromising program security or requiring activation of Admin mode.
